Faq

Can I deploy a bot I already have?

Yes. You can use SetupBot to set up and deploy an existing bot.

Who pays for hosting?

You pay the cloud provider if you rent a server. If you use your own server, you cover its operating costs.

Will my bot run when my laptop is closed?

Yes. The bot runs on the server you choose. If that server loses power or its internet connection, tasks that rely on it may pause or fail until service is restored.

How much does cloud hosting cost?

Pro costs $20/month, Plus costs $50/month, and Max costs $100/month. The one-time setup fee is separate.

Do I need to buy new hardware?

You can reuse a compatible computer or server that can stay online. If you buy a barebones mini PC, check whether it includes RAM, storage, and a power adapter before ordering separate parts.

Do I need a GPU?

The listed cloud tiers are CPU-only. Bots that use a hosted model API can run without a local GPU. If you plan to run a model on the server itself, check that model’s hardware requirements.

What other costs should I expect?

For a cloud server, your provider may charge for extras such as backups or bandwidth. For your own server, budget for hardware, electricity, and internet. Paid model APIs and integrations can have separate fees.

What happens after I select a plan?

The setup page shows the selected plan, its server specs where applicable, and the one-time setup fee. You can enter sample details and preview payment.
